nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_000
nodes.question: How do NGOs and lobby organizations function in the governance landscape in Europe?
nodes.answer: NGOs and lobby organizations are active across various governance levels simultaneously, contributing to the complexity of the governance landscape in Europe.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What organizations recognize the urgency for climate action?
nodes.answer: The United Nations (UN) and World Health Organization (WHO) recognize the urgency for climate action.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Which organizations have gained support for the multi-stakeholder approach mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Some UN agencies, including UNEP, FAO, and UNDP, have gained support for the multi-stakeholder approach.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_003
nodes.question: Who are some of the contributors mentioned in the document related to the Global Goal for Nature?
nodes.answer: Contributors include Locke, Rockström, Bakker, Bapna, Gough, Lambertini, Morris, Zabey, and Zurita.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_004
nodes.question: Who are some of the authors mentioned in the publication "A Nature-Positive World: the Global Goal for Nature"?
nodes.answer: Some of the authors include H. Locke, J. Rockström, P. Bakker, M. Bapna, and J. Morris.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_005
nodes.question: Who are some of the authors mentioned in the publication "A Nature-Positive World: the Global Goal for Nature"?
nodes.answer: Some authors mentioned include Locke, Rockström, Bakker, Bapna, Gough, Lambertini, Morris, Zabey, and Zurita.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_006
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What is the role of non-state actors in the UNFCCC process according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Non-state actors, including NGOs and IGOs, contribute informally to the UNFCCC process by sharing expertise, overseeing progress, and supporting ambition through side events, helping to improve representation and procedural justice despite not participating directly in decision-making for negotiation texts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_007
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: How do ECAs compare to private capital or multilateral financial institutions regarding their alignment with national climate policy objectives?
nodes.answer: ECAs, as institutions under the control of national governments, are better positioned to respond to national climate policy objectives compared to private capital or multilateral financial institutions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_008
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: Which organizations advocate for the inclusion of GHG emission limits in the IED?
nodes.answer: Environmental associations and think tanks such as ClientEarth and CarbonMarketWatch advocate for the inclusion of GHG emission limits in the IED.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|International climate agreements|Role of non-governmental organizations (ngos)_qna_009
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Which organizations are indicated in the paragraph as working in the realm of agriculture and environmental policy?
nodes.answer: The European Union (EU) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations are mentioned as relevant organizations.
